idea-plugin.name: Java Insight
idea-plugin.description:
Java Insight is a powerful IntelliJ IDEA plugin designed for comprehensive runtime analysis and debugging of Java applications.
User Guide:https://gcnleuhnn80f.feishu.cn/wiki/CBFJw1o4SioOhlkrlZicRPkjnQb

🎯 Key Features:
  • Method Call Chain Tracking：Real-time monitoring of Java method execution, capturing complete call chains
  • Visual Call Graph：Intuitively display real method call relationships during runtime, quickly understand system architecture
  • Hotswap Support：Update method body code without restarting the application, improving development efficiency
  • Remote Debugging：Connect to remote JVM processes for real-time debugging and monitoring
  • Recording Capability：Record input and output parameters of running methods
  • Groovy Script Support：Dynamically execute scripts to manipulate runtime JVM state
  • Data Persistence：Store call records for subsequent analysis and issue identification

Java Insight provides unprecedented runtime insights for developers, helping you quickly understand code execution paths, identify performance bottlenecks, optimize system architecture, and make Java development more efficient and controllable.

--------------------------------------------------
Java Insight是一款强大的IntelliJ IDEA插件，为Java开发者提供全面的运行时分析和调试能力。
使用文档：https://gcnleuhnn80f.feishu.cn/wiki/CBFJw1o4SioOhlkrlZicRPkjnQb

🎯 核心功能：
  • 方法调用链追踪：实时监控Java方法执行，捕获完整调用链路
  • 可视化调用图：直观展示运行中真实的方法间调用关系图，快速理解系统结构
  • 热更新支持：无需重启应用即可热更新方法体代码，提升开发效率
  • 远程调试能力：连接远程JVM进程进行实时调试和监控
  • 录制能力：录制运行方法的出入参
  • Groovy脚本支持：动态执行脚本操作运行时JVM状态
  • 数据持久化：存储调用记录，便于后续分析和问题定位

Java Insight为开发者提供了前所未有的运行时洞察能力，帮助你快速理解代码执行路径、定位性能瓶颈、优化系统架构，让Java开发更加高效和可控。
